name: What is the process for getting energy-efficient upgrades with Hometelligent Inc.?

mainEntity.name: What is the process for getting energy-efficient upgrades with Hometelligent Inc.?

acceptedAnswer.text: The process begins with an initial consultation where we discuss your goals and conduct a thorough home assessment. This helps us identify areas for improvement and propose suitable energy-efficient solutions. Next, we provide a detailed proposal outlining the recommended upgrades, timelines, and costs. Once approved, our team schedules and executes the work, ensuring minimal disruption. Finally, we conduct a walkthrough to confirm your satisfaction. Customers in Emeryville or Dublin often find our structured approach streamlines the project.
acceptedAnswer.description: Our process involves an initial consultation, home assessment, detailed proposal, project execution, and final walkthrough to ensure satisfaction.
